posts.headline: 5-Ingredient Chickpea Curry
points: Fry 1 onion with 2 tsp curry powder in a little oil
Add 1 can chickpeas and 1 can chopped tomatoes
Stir in 200 ml coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes
Wilt in spinach, season and serve with rice

posts.headline: Where Vegans Get Vitamin B12
points: B12 occurs naturally in animal foods only
Plant foods contain B12 only when fortified
Look for fortified plant drinks, cereals and nutritional yeast
Many vegans take a B12 supplement: ask a health professional
posts.caption: B12 is the one nutrient every vegan should plan for from day one. Plant foods only provide it when it has been added, so fortified foods or a supplement are the reliable routes.

posts.headline: Egg Swaps for Baking

3 tbsp aquafaba ≈ 1 egg white
60 g mashed banana works in sweet bakes
60 g unsweetened applesauce keeps cakes moist
posts.caption: There's no single perfect egg swap, so pick one by its job. Flax binds, aquafaba whips, and banana or applesauce add moisture.

posts.headline: Cut Food Waste at Home
points: Plan meals and shop with a list
Store herbs in a glass of water in the fridge
Freeze bread and overripe bananas
Turn veg scraps into stock
posts.caption: The greenest food is the food you actually eat. Small habits keep good ingredients out of the bin.
posts.call_to_action: Share your best anti-waste tip.

posts.headline: One-Pot Red Lentil Soup
points: Soften 1 onion, 1 carrot and 2 garlic cloves
Add 150 g red lentils, 1 tsp cumin and 1 litre stock
Simmer about 20 minutes until the lentils collapse
Blend half, stir back in, finish with lemon
posts.caption: This is a cosy, budget-friendly soup that freezes well. It serves 4 and costs very little per bowl.
posts.call_to_action: Would you add chilli or keep it mild?

posts.headline: Don't Forget Iodine
points: Vegans can fall short on iodine without some planning
Many plant drinks are not fortified with iodine: check labels
Fortified foods or a supplement are reliable options
Ask a health professional which option suits you
posts.caption: Iodine rarely gets talked about, but it matters. It's easy to cover once you know to look for it on labels.
posts.call_to_action: Did you know about iodine? Answer yes or no in the comments.

Point 2: Many plant drinks are not fortified with iodine: check labels. Point 3: Fortified foods or a supplement are reliable options. Point 4: Ask a health professional which option suits you.

posts.headline: Swap Mince for Lentils
points: A drained 400 g can of lentils stands in for about 250 g mince
Add finely chopped mushrooms for a meaty texture
A spoon of soy sauce or miso adds savoury depth
Works in bolognese, chilli, shepherd's pie and tacos
posts.caption: Lentils are the easiest mince swap there is: cheap, quick and good at soaking up flavour. Nobody at the table needs to know.
posts.call_to_action: Save this for your next pasta night.
posts.alt_text: Vegan Leaf graphic with a cream and forest-green design. Headline: Swap Mince for Lentils. Point 1: A drained 400 g can of lentils stands in for about 250 g mince. Point 2: Add finely chopped mushrooms for a meaty texture. Point 3: A spoon of soy sauce or miso adds savoury depth. Point 4: Works in bolognese, chilli, shepherd's pie and tacos.

posts.headline: Use By vs Best Before
points: 'Use by' is about safety: don't eat food after this date
'Best before' is about quality: food is often fine after it
Look, smell and taste-check food past its best before date
Freeze food before its use-by date to keep it longer
posts.caption: Knowing the difference saves money and stops good food going in the bin. Always follow 'use by' dates.
posts.call_to_action: Save this and share it with your housemates.

Point 4: Freeze food before its use-by date to keep it longer.

posts.headline: Lentils at a Glance
points: Red: cooks in about 15 minutes, great for dal and soup
Brown or green: holds its shape, good for salads and ragù
Black (beluga): firm and glossy, ideal for salads
No soaking needed: just rinse and cook
posts.caption: Lentils are cheap, quick and endlessly useful. Knowing which colour to grab makes the difference between mush and a perfect salad.
posts.call_to_action: Which lentil is in your cupboard right now?

Point 2: Brown or green: holds its shape, good for salads and ragù. Point 3: Black (beluga): firm and glossy, ideal for salads. Point 4: No soaking needed: just rinse and cook.

posts.headline: Myth: Plant Iron Doesn't Count
points: Myth: iron from plants is useless
Fact: it's absorbed less efficiently, but it still counts
Vitamin C at the same meal improves absorption
Vegetarians may need almost twice as much, per the NIH
posts.caption: Plant iron absolutely counts, and you just plan for it. Lentils with tomatoes, or beans with peppers, are easy wins.
posts.call_to_action: What's your favourite iron-rich combo?

posts.headline: Nutrients to Plan For
points: Vitamin B12 and iodine: fortified foods or supplements
Vitamin D, especially in autumn and winter
Omega-3: flax, chia, walnuts, hemp
Calcium and iron from a varied, well-planned diet
posts.caption: A well-planned vegan diet covers your needs, and planning is the key word. Talk to a doctor or dietitian before starting supplements.

posts.headline: Seasonal Shopping Made Simple
points: Check what's abundant and good value at the market
Build meals around one seasonal hero ingredient
Freeze or pickle gluts for later
Canned and frozen veg fill the gaps
posts.caption: Seasonal produce is often tastier and better value. Let the season pick your star ingredient.

posts.headline: Crispy Tofu Rice Bowl
points: Press and cube 200 g firm tofu, toss with 1 tbsp cornflour
Pan-fry until golden on all sides, about 10 minutes
Glaze with soy sauce, maple syrup and garlic
Serve over rice with cucumber, carrot and sesame
posts.caption: The cornflour coating is the secret to crunchy tofu. Don't crowd the pan and let each side brown before you turn it.
posts.call_to_action: Save this and tell us how crispy yours gets.

Point 2: Pan-fry until golden on all sides, about 10 minutes. Point 3: Glaze with soy sauce, maple syrup and garlic. Point 4: Serve over rice with cucumber, carrot and sesame.

posts.headline: Vitamin D Through the Year
points: Your skin makes vitamin D from sunlight in spring and summer
The NHS suggests considering a supplement in autumn and winter
Some vitamin D3 is animal-derived, so check it's labelled vegan
Fortified spreads, cereals and plant drinks can contribute
posts.caption: Vitamin D advice depends on where you live and how much sun you get. In the UK, the NHS suggests that everyone considers a supplement in the darker months, vegans included.
posts.call_to_action: Save this as a reminder for when the clocks change.

Point 2: The NHS suggests considering a supplement in autumn and winter. Point 3: Some vitamin D3 is animal-derived, so check it's labelled vegan. Point 4: Fortified spreads, cereals and plant drinks can contribute.

posts.headline: Honey and Gelatin Alternatives
points: Maple syrup or agave replaces honey 1:1 in most recipes
Date syrup brings a deep caramel flavour to baking
Agar agar sets like gelatin but must be boiled to activate
Check jelly sweets and some desserts for gelatin
posts.caption: Honey and gelatin turn up in unexpected places. These swaps keep your bakes and desserts fully plant-based.
posts.call_to_action: Did you know gelatin is animal-derived? Yes or no?

Point 2: Date syrup brings a deep caramel flavour to baking. Point 3: Agar agar sets like gelatin but must be boiled to activate. Point 4: Check jelly sweets and some desserts for gelatin.

posts.headline: Shopping the Plant Milk Shelf
points: Pick unsweetened versions for cooking
Check for added calcium, vitamin D and B12
Some organic versions are not fortified: read the label
Long-life cartons are great for stocking up
posts.caption: Plant milks vary a lot from carton to carton. A 10-second label check helps you pick one that works for your coffee and your nutrition.

posts.headline: Jackfruit: A Texture Swap
points: Buy young green jackfruit in water or brine, not syrup
Rinse, then shred it with two forks
Simmer in BBQ sauce for pulled-style sandwiches
Add beans or tofu for a more filling meal
posts.caption: Young jackfruit shreds into a pulled texture and takes on any sauce you give it. Treat it as a texture ingredient and build the rest of the meal around it.

posts.headline: Myth: Unwashed Veg Provides B12
points: Myth: you'll get B12 from soil on vegetables
Fact: plant foods are not a reliable B12 source
B12 is found naturally only in animal foods
Use fortified foods or a supplement
posts.caption: This myth is common, and it's risky. B12 is the one nutrient you shouldn't leave to chance.
posts.call_to_action: Share this with a new vegan friend.

Point 2: Fact: plant foods are not a reliable B12 source. Point 3: B12 is found naturally only in animal foods. Point 4: Use fortified foods or a supplement.

Days 5–7: try three new vegan dinners

posts.headline: Small Swaps, Real Impact
points: Swap beef for beans or lentils a few times a week
Try plant milk in your coffee
Make one meal a day fully plant-based
Meat and dairy generally have the highest footprints
posts.caption: You don't have to be perfect to make a difference. Consistent small swaps add up over a year.
